name: PSYCHIC
text: A tag with no effect of its own. Rules of other teams read it (a Null Rod switches PSYCHIC weapons and actions off nearby).

name: MUTATION
text: Cult operatives mutate as a free strategic gambit each turning point, and a Devotee may mutate after it incapacitates an enemy within its control range. A mutation turns a Devotee into a Mutant, a Mutant into a Torment (twice per turning point at most), or regains up to D3+1 lost wounds. No more than five Mutants and three Torments at once, and no operative mutates twice in one turning point.

name: ACCURSED GIFTS
text: The first Devotee to become a Mutant earns the team a primary gift that every Mutant has; the first Mutant to become a Torment earns a secondary gift that every Torment has as well. No gift is chosen twice in a battle.

name: Deformed Wings
text: Any climb costs 2" of movement whatever its height, and drops cost nothing.

name: Fleet
text: Add 1" to its Move.

name: Chitinous
text: Improve its Save by 1.

name: Horned
text: When it ends a Charge move, it may inflict 1 damage (D3 for a Torment) on one enemy in its control range.

name: Sinewed
text: Its melee weapons ignore the Hit change from being injured and have Brutal.

name: Barbed
text: While it fights or retaliates, enemies cannot assist; on its first strike of the sequence every other enemy in its control range takes 1 damage (D3 each, rolled separately, for a Torment).

name: Cut Them Down
text: An enemy that Falls Back from a Blessed Blade's control range takes D3+1 damage before it moves (2D3+2 once if two Blessed Blades hold it).

name: Attuned In Purpose
text: When a Blessed Blade activates, it may activate the other ready Blessed Blade within 6" with it, and the two act action by action in any order.

name: Icon Bearer
text: Counts as 1 higher APL when control of a marker is worked out (not a change to its APL).

name: Group Activation
text: When a Devotee is expended, the cult must next activate one other ready Devotee. That one does not chain on.

name: Accursed Mutant
text: Cannot perform unique actions. Pick Up Marker and mission actions cost 1 more AP (Operate Hatch excepted).

name: Unnatural Regeneration
text: Whenever an attack die would inflict 3 or more damage on it, roll a D6: on a 5+ that damage is 1 lower.

name: Accursed Torment
text: Can only use the weapons on its datacard and cannot perform Pick Up Marker, unique or mission actions (Operate Hatch excepted).

name: Brute
text: On Conceal, it cannot use Light terrain to count as in cover when an enemy selects a valid target; it keeps its cover save.

name: INCITE SLAUGHTER
text: SUPPORT. Another friendly cult operative visible to and within 9" of the Demagogue immediately performs a free Fight action (it still needs an enemy in its control range).

name: INCITE URGENCY
text: SUPPORT. Another friendly cult operative visible to and within 9" of the Demagogue immediately performs a free Dash, or a free Charge that moves no more than 3".

name: RUINOUS ICON
text: PSYCHIC. Pick Invigoration (friendly cult operatives within 4" of the Iconarch take 1 less from each Normal or Critical Dmg of 4 or more) or Deterioration (enemies within 4" take 1 more from each Normal and Critical Dmg). It lasts until the start of the Iconarch's next activation, its incapacitation or its next use of this action.

name: HEINOUS DELUGE
text: PSYCHIC. An enemy operative that is a valid target for the Mindwitch has 1 less APL until the end of its next activation.

name: MALEFIC VORTEX
text: PSYCHIC. Remove your Malefic Vortex marker if it is in the killzone, then place it visible to the Mindwitch or on Vantage terrain of a visible feature. Each enemy within 2" of it takes 1 damage now and again in the Ready step of each later Strategy phase.
